hits.text: 2. **Fasi–Higham diagonal reciprocal Padé positivity.** Exact surviving question: for every odd m>=1 and every n>=0, [z^n](sum_(j=0)^m (-1)^j binom(m,j)(2m-j)!/(2m)! z^j)^(-1)>0. [Scardino2610.39051v1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.39051v1), pp2–3, explicitly retains diagonal k=m after refuting unrestricted k,m. No exact ID/Fasi/Higham hit in the qualified history. Closest actual body: Theorem8.5 and its recurrence counterexamples, plus the diagonal caveat in Sections1–2; those examples have k!=m and do not refute this question. **Mechanism:** reverse-Bessel denominator recurrence, or a positive renewal representation for reciprocal coefficients. **Decisive calculation:** derive an induction coupling the diagonal orders m and m+2 that absorbs the negative even-j recurrence terms, uniformly in coefficient index n. **Objection:** fixed-m eventual pole dominance is insufficient for ALL n and is not uniform in diagonal m. This is an explicitly surviving subcase of ONE Padé family, not a fresh family for each m. Original Fasi–Higham publisher proof body not obtained, so no major computation or novelty claim.
